leads.name: Lead Management
leads.description: Track and manage potential customers through your sales funnel.

capabilities.create_lead: Click 'Add Lead' button in the Leads page header to create a new lead manually.
capabilities.edit_lead: Click the pencil (Edit) icon on any lead row to modify its details.
capabilities.delete_lead: Click the trash (Delete) icon on a lead row. Only admins and managers can delete leads.
capabilities.convert_lead: Click the 'Convert' button on a lead row. This moves the lead into the Deals pipeline as an active opportunity. Converted leads cannot be converted again.
capabilities.lead_scoring: PULSE uses AI to automatically score leads based on Fit Score (company/industry match) and Engagement Score (email opens, meetings, activity). Scores range from 0-100.
capabilities.priority_view: Toggle 'Priority View' in the Leads page header to sort leads by AI score. The highest-scoring lead is highlighted with a accent border.
capabilities.lead_sources: Leads can come from: Website, Referral, LinkedIn, Cold Email, Event, Webinar, Partner, Paid Ads, Organic Search, or Other.
capabilities.lead_owner: Each lead has an assigned owner responsible for following up.

deals.name: Deal Pipeline
deals.description: Visual Kanban pipeline to track sales opportunities from prospecting to close.

capabilities.view_pipeline: Click 'Pipeline' or 'Deals' in the sidebar to see the Kanban board view.
capabilities.create_deal: Click 'Add Deal' button in the Pipeline view to create a new deal.
capabilities.move_deal: Drag and drop deal cards between pipeline stages on the Kanban board.
capabilities.deal_value: Each deal has an estimated value used for revenue forecasting.
capabilities.weighted_forecast: Pipeline calculates weighted forecast by multiplying deal value by stage probability (e.g., Proposal = 40%, Negotiation = 70%).
capabilities.deal_owner: Each deal has an assigned owner responsible for closing it.

contacts.name: Contact Management
contacts.description: Manage individual people you communicate with at companies.

capabilities.create_contact: Click 'Add Contact' in the Contacts page. Fill in name, email, phone, job title, and optional company link.
capabilities.edit_contact: Click the edit icon on any contact row to update details.
capabilities.delete_contact: Only admins and managers can delete contacts.
capabilities.link_to_company: Contacts can be linked to a Company record to build account-level relationships.

companies.name: Company Management
companies.description: Track B2B account records for organizations you sell to.

capabilities.create_company: Click 'Add Company' in the Companies page. Add domain, industry, employee count, annual revenue.
capabilities.edit_company: Click the edit icon to update company details.
capabilities.delete_company: Only admins and managers can delete companies.
capabilities.linked_records: Companies link to Contacts, Leads, and Deals for a 360-degree account view.

emails.name: Email Integration
emails.description: Send and sync emails directly from PULSE CRM via Gmail.

capabilities.connect_gmail: Go to Integrations page and connect your Gmail account via OAuth. This enables email sync and sending.
capabilities.send_email: From a Lead detail view, click the 'Email' action button. Compose and send directly through your connected Gmail.
capabilities.email_sync: PULSE automatically syncs incoming and outgoing emails linked to leads and contacts.
capabilities.email_thread_summary: AI can summarize long email threads to extract key points, sentiment, and action items.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: Schedule and manage meetings, calls, follow-ups, and demos.

capabilities.view_calendar: Click 'Calendar' in the sidebar to see all scheduled events.
capabilities.create_event: Click to add a new calendar event — meetings, calls, follow-ups, demos, or tasks.
capabilities.event_types: Events can be: Meeting, Call, Follow-up, Demo, Task, or Reminder.
capabilities.link_to_records: Calendar events can be linked to Leads, Contacts, Companies, or Deals.

activities.name: Activity Timeline
activities.description: Immutable event log tracking all interactions across your CRM.

capabilities.view_timeline: Each Lead, Deal, Contact, and Company has an Activity Timeline tab showing all history.
capabilities.activity_types: Tracks: calls, emails, meetings, notes, system events, and AI actions.
capabilities.log_activity: Activities are automatically logged when you perform actions (send email, log call, schedule meeting).

ai_insights.name: AI Insights
ai_insights.description: AI-powered lead scoring, recommendations, and conversation intelligence.

capabilities.lead_scoring: AI scores each lead based on fit (company/industry match) and engagement (activity level). View scores in the Priority View.
capabilities.next_best_action: When viewing a lead, the AI suggests the next best action to take (e.g., 'Follow up with pricing details').
capabilities.conversation_summary: AI summarizes email threads to extract key points, sentiment, intent, and suggested replies.
capabilities.batch_recommendations: Get AI recommendations for all leads at once in the Priority View.

capabilities.dashboards: Each role has a tailored dashboard: Sales Rep sees personal pipeline, Manager sees team metrics, Admin sees full organization overview.
capabilities.report_builder: Click 'New Report' to build custom reports with filters and grouping.
capabilities.export_reports: Reports can be exported. Managers and admins can export; sales reps can view and export.
capabilities.forecast: View pipeline forecast with weighted deal values and close date projections.
capabilities.team_performance: Managers and admins can view team performance metrics and leaderboards.

settings.name: Settings & Integrations
settings.description: Configure your account, integrations, and system preferences.

capabilities.profile: Update your name, email, timezone, and avatar in the Profile page.
capabilities.integrations: Connect Gmail, SMTP, Brevo for email. Manage webhook subscriptions.
capabilities.notifications: View and manage in-app notifications for deal updates, lead assignments, and system events.
capabilities.documents: Upload and manage files (attachments, avatars) in the Documents page.

create_lead.title: How to Create a Lead
steps: Navigate to the **Leads** page from the sidebar.
Click the **Add Lead** button in the top-right corner.
Fill in the lead details: Name, Company, Email, Phone, Source, Industry, etc.
Select the **Status** (default is New) and **Priority**.
Click **Save** to create the lead.

convert_lead.title: How to Convert a Lead
steps: Go to the **Leads** page and find the lead you want to convert.
Click the **Convert** button on the lead row.
In the conversion dialog, optionally update Industry, Revenue, and Employee Count.
Select a **Pipeline Stage** for the new deal.
Click **Convert** to move the lead into the Deals pipeline.
The lead status changes to 'Converted' and a new Deal is created.

manage_pipeline.title: How to Manage the Deal Pipeline
steps: Navigate to **Pipeline** or **Deals** in the sidebar.
View the Kanban board with deals organized by pipeline stage.
Drag and drop deal cards to move them between stages.
Click **Add Deal** to create a new deal directly in a pipeline stage.
The weighted forecast updates automatically as deals move.

send_email.title: How to Send an Email
steps: Make sure your Gmail is connected in **Integrations** settings.
Open a Lead detail view by clicking on a lead.
Click the **Email** action button.
Enter the Subject and compose your email body.
Click **Send** to send the email through your connected Gmail.

log_call.title: How to Log a Call
steps: Open a Lead detail view by clicking on a lead.
Click the **Log Call** action button.
Select the call outcome (e.g., 'Spoke with Lead', 'Left Voicemail', 'No Answer').
Add notes about the call.
Click **Save** to log the call to the activity timeline.

schedule_meeting.title: How to Schedule a Meeting
steps: Open a Lead detail view by clicking on a lead.
Click the **Meet** action button.
Enter the meeting Title, Date, Time, and Description/Agenda.
Click **Save** to schedule the meeting.

use_priority_view.title: How to Use Priority View
steps: Go to the **Leads** page.
Click the **Priority View** toggle button in the header.
Leads are now sorted by AI score (highest first).
The top lead is highlighted with an accent border.
View Fit Score, Engagement Score, Overall Score, and AI Recommendation for each lead.
Toggle off to return to the standard list view.

view_reports.title: How to View Reports
steps: Click **Reports** in the sidebar.
Browse the available report types and dashboards.
Use the Report Builder to create custom reports.
Export reports using the export button (Managers and Admins only).

admin.name: Administrator
admin.description: Full access to all features and settings.
can: Create, edit, and delete all CRM records (leads, deals, contacts, companies)
Delete leads, deals, contacts, and companies
Assign leads and deals to team members
Manage users (create, edit, delete, activate, deactivate)

manager.name: Manager
manager.description: Manage team and CRM data, but limited system admin access.
can: Create, edit all CRM records (leads, deals, contacts, companies)
Assign leads and deals to team members

sales_rep.name: Sales Representative
sales_rep.description: Day-to-day CRM usage for sales activities.
can: Create, edit leads, deals, contacts, companies
cannot: Delete any CRM records (leads, deals, contacts, companies)
Assign leads or deals to others

faq.question: What is PULSE CRM?
faq.answer: PULSE CRM (KALNET PULSE) is an enterprise Customer Relationship Management platform for B2B sales and marketing teams. It helps you manage leads, deals, contacts, companies, emails, and activities — all with AI-powered insights.

faq.question: How do I reset my password?
faq.answer: Go to the **Settings** page and update your password from the Profile section. If you're locked out, contact your admin.

faq.question: What is lead scoring?
faq.answer: Lead scoring is an AI-powered feature that automatically scores leads from 0-100 based on two factors: **Fit Score** (how well the lead matches your ideal customer profile) and **Engagement Score** (how actively they interact with your emails and meetings).

faq.question: What does the Priority View do?
faq.answer: Priority View sorts your leads by AI score (highest first) so you can focus on the most promising opportunities first. Toggle it on/off using the **Priority View** button in the Leads page header.

faq.question: How do I connect my Gmail?
faq.answer: Go to **Integrations** in the sidebar, find the Gmail section, and click **Connect Gmail**. You'll be redirected to Google OAuth to authorize PULSE to access your email. Once connected, you can send and sync emails directly from the CRM.

faq.question: Can I undo a lead conversion?
faq.answer: No, lead conversion is permanent. Once a lead is converted, it moves to the Deals pipeline and its status is set to 'Converted'. Make sure you're ready to convert before proceeding.

faq.question: How does the AI recommendation work?
faq.answer: The AI analyzes your lead's fit score, engagement score, recent activity, email interactions, and meeting history to suggest the **next best action** — like 'Follow up with pricing' or 'Schedule a demo call'.

faq.question: What's the difference between a Lead and a Deal?
faq.answer: A **Lead** is a potential customer you're prospecting. A **Deal** is an active sales opportunity in your pipeline. When a lead is qualified, you **convert** it into a Deal to track it through your sales pipeline.

faq.question: How do I add a new team member?
faq.answer: Admins can go to **Users** in the sidebar and click **Add User**. Managers can also create users. Fill in their name, email, assign a role, and they'll receive an invitation.

faq.question: Can I customize the pipeline stages?
faq.answer: Yes, admins and managers can manage pipeline stages. Go to **Pipeline** settings to add, edit, or reorder stages. Each stage has a name, color, and probability percentage used for forecasting.

faq.question: How do I upload a file or document?
faq.answer: Go to **Documents** in the sidebar and click the upload button. You can upload images (JPEG, PNG, WebP), PDFs, and Word documents. Files are stored securely and can be attached to CRM records.

faq.question: What notifications will I receive?
faq.answer: PULSE sends in-app notifications for events like: lead assignment, deal stage changes, deal won/lost, new activities, and system updates. View them in the **Notifications** page.

glossary.Lead: A potential customer or prospect that hasn't been qualified yet.
glossary.Deal: An active sales opportunity being tracked through your pipeline.
glossary.Contact: An individual person you communicate with at a company.
glossary.Company: A B2B account record representing an organization.
glossary.Pipeline: The visual stages a deal moves through from prospecting to close.
glossary.Pipeline Stage: A step in your sales process (e.g., Prospecting, Proposal, Negotiation, Won, Lost).
glossary.Fit Score: How well a lead matches your ideal customer profile based on company size, industry, etc.
glossary.Engagement Score: How actively a lead interacts with your emails, meetings, and activities.
glossary.Priority Tier: Classification of leads: Critical, High, Medium, or Low based on overall score.
glossary.Weighted Forecast: Revenue projection calculated by multiplying deal value by stage probability.
glossary.Activity Timeline: Chronological log of all interactions (calls, emails, meetings, notes) for a record.
glossary.Lead Conversion: The process of moving a qualified Lead into the Deals pipeline.
glossary.Owner: The team member assigned to manage a lead or deal.
glossary.Gmail Integration: OAuth connection that enables email sync and sending from within PULSE.
glossary.Webhook: Outbound HTTP notifications triggered by CRM events.
glossary.RBAC: Role-Based Access Control — permissions assigned based on user roles (Admin, Manager, Sales Rep).
